rejections.phone_outside_ranges: Its country hands out no number like this one: check it (example: {{example}}). With + in front, the country code chooses the country.
rejections.establishment_code: This code is not written that way: it takes the shape of {{example}}.
rejections.code_kept: Numbered documents carry this code: it no longer changes.
rejections.default_kept: The company always keeps one default establishment: make another one the default instead.
rejections.sequence_from: This series resumes at {{next}} or above: no number is given twice.
rejections.numbering_format: Format refused: text (letters, digits, spaces, _ . / -) around {YYYY}, {YY}, {MM}, {EST} and one sequence only, {SEQ} or {SEQ:n} on 1 to {{max}} digits (example: FA-{YYYY}-{SEQ:5}).
rejections.format_prints_year: A series that starts again each year prints the year, {YYYY} or {YY}: otherwise the first number of a year is one already given.
rejections.format_prints_month: A series that starts again each month prints the month and the year, {MM} with {YYYY} or {YY}: otherwise the first number of a month is one already given.
rejections.choices_count: A choice field offers 1 to {{max}} choices.
rejections.choice_twice: This choice is already offered: remove one of the two.
rejections.name_required: A contact has a first or a last name: fill in one of them.
rejections.customer_merged_choose: Customer “{{number}}” was merged into “{{kept}}”: choose “{{kept}}” instead.
rejections.quantity_priced_twice: This product already has a price from this quantity: remove one of the two rows.
rejections.customer_or_group: A price list is for one customer or for one group, not both: choose one of them.
rejections.tax_twice: {{tax}} is chosen twice: remove one of the two.
rejections.tax_on_line: {{tax}} is charged on each line, not on the whole document: add it to the lines.
rejections.discount_rate_or_amount: A discount is a percentage or an amount, not both: clear one of the two.
rejections.invalid_discount: Discount refused: an amount from 0, with at most {{decimals}} decimals.
rejections.discount_above_total: The document’s discount is more than its lines come to: lower it.
rejections.line_discount_above_total: The discount is more than the line comes to: lower it.
rejections.lot_not_tracked: This product is tracked by neither lot nor serial number: leave the lot empty.
rejections.lot_code: A lot is 1 to {{max}} characters, without spaces or accents (example: L2026-03).
rejections.returned_needs_product: Only a line naming a product puts goods back in stock: choose the product, or untick the return to stock.
rejections.customer_deactivated: Customer “{{number}}” is deactivated: choose another, or reactivate it in Customers.
rejections.product_deactivated: Product “{{reference}}” is deactivated: choose another, or reactivate it in Products.
rejections.product_merged_choose: Product “{{reference}}” was merged into “{{kept}}”: choose “{{kept}}” instead.
rejections.vendor_deactivated: Vendor “{{number}}” is deactivated: choose another, or reactivate it in Vendors.
rejections.amount_too_large: The amount is more than a document can hold: lower the quantity or the price.
rejections.named_twice: This delivery note is named twice: remove one of the two.
rejections.not_an_invoice: Delivery notes are added to an invoice, never to a credit note or a deposit invoice: choose an invoice.
rejections.notes_other_party: These notes are for another customer or establishment than the invoice: choose an invoice of their customer and establishment.
rejections.notes_one_customer: An invoice is made from the notes of one customer: choose notes of the same customer.
rejections.notes_one_establishment: An invoice is made from the notes of one establishment, whose series numbers it: choose notes of the same establishment.
rejections.source_quote_or_invoice: A line delivers a quote line or an invoice line, never both: the invoice already billed what the quote offered.
rejections.line_drawn_once: This line is already on the document: change the quantity of the line already there instead.
rejections.one_source_document: A delivery note delivers one document, and these lines come from {{count}}: make one note for each.
rejections.other_lines_of_source: A note delivering “{{reference}}” carries its lines only: make another note for anything else.
rejections.customer_of_source: A note delivering “{{reference}}” goes to its customer, {{name}}.
rejections.establishment_of_source: A note delivering “{{reference}}” leaves its establishment, {{code}}.
rejections.source_product: A line taken from another document keeps its product: add another line for anything else.
rejections.source_unit: A line taken from another document counts in its unit, “{{unit}}”.
rejections.source_price: A line taken from another document keeps its price, {{price}}.
rejections.source_taxes: A line taken from another document keeps its taxes.
rejections.file_empty: This file is empty: choose another.
rejections.file_too_large: This file is over {{bytes}}: choose a lighter one.
rejections.file_not_received: This file did not arrive whole: choose it again.
rejections.file_type: This type of file is not kept: choose a {{types}} file.
rejections.picture_too_wide: This picture is over {{pixels}} pixels on a side: make it smaller, then try again.
rejections.too_many_files: There {max, plural, one {is already {{max}} file} other {are already {{max}} files}} here, the most kept: take one off before adding another.
rejections.breached: This password appears in known data breaches: choose another one.
rejections.company_name_taken: A company already has this name here: choose another, for example by adding your town.
rejections.period_longest: Period refused: a report reads {{days}} {days, plural, one {day} other {days}} at most. Bring the end closer to the start, or read the period in several parts.
rejections.not_by_establishment: This report is read for the whole company only: choose “The whole company”.
rejections.compare_today: This report reads today, which has nothing to be compared with: choose “Nothing”.
rejections.after_today: Date refused: today at the latest.
rejections.nothing_to_apply: Nothing to apply: the customer has no credit, or nothing is left to pay.
rejections.above_credit: The customer has only {{amount}} to their credit.
rejections.source_note_cancelled: The delivery note of this line was cancelled since: its goods are back in stock and nothing of it is left to invoice. Remove the line.
rejections.not_a_deposit: “{{reference}}” is not a deposit invoice: only a deposit is given back on another invoice.
rejections.deposit_not_issued: The deposit “{{reference}}” is given back once issued, and no longer once a credit note corrects it.
rejections.deposit_given_back: The deposit “{{reference}}” is already given back by invoice “{{invoice}}”.
rejections.deposit_on_draft: The deposit “{{reference}}” is already given back by a draft invoice: remove it from that draft first.
rejections.operations_unknown: Say what this invoice’s operations are: deliveries of goods, services, or both. A line naming no product says nothing of it.
rejections.excess_to: {{amount}} of this credit note was already paid: say whether it goes to the customer’s credit or is refunded.
rejections.deposits_beyond_quote: A quote’s deposits never go beyond it: {{amount}} net of tax is left of it.
rejections.no_operation_category: This company’s invoices state no category of operations: its country’s law asks for none.
rejections.deposit_not_given_back: A credit note gives back only the deposits the invoice it corrects gave back.
rejections.source_note_line_not_drafted: A line invoices a delivery note line only when its draft already did: an invoice of delivery notes is made from the notes.
rejections.above_uncovered: A cheque or bill covers at most what is still due and not covered by another, {{amount}}.
rejections.credit_note_no_discount: A credit note gives back its share of its invoice’s discount: it takes none of its own.
rejections.credit_note_customer: A credit note goes to the customer of the invoice it corrects.
rejections.notes_keep_customer: An invoice of delivery notes stays with their customer: remove their lines first.
rejections.notes_keep_establishment: An invoice of delivery notes stays with their establishment: remove their lines first.
rejections.only_invoice_takes_lines: Only an invoice takes the lines of other documents.
rejections.deposit_takes_no_lines: A deposit invoice takes no other document’s lines.
rejections.above_due: A payment is at most what is still due, {{amount}}.
rejections.above_creditable: A credit note gives back at most what “{{reference}}” invoiced, less its earlier credit notes: {{amount}}.
rejections.returned_credit_note_only: Only a credit note returns goods to stock.
rejections.credited_line_of_invoice: A credit note’s line gives back a line of the invoice it corrects.
rejections.deposit_gives_no_deposit: A deposit invoice gives no other deposit back.
rejections.deposit_other_customer: An invoice gives back only the deposits of its own customer.
rejections.deduction_line_shape: A line giving a deposit back counts one, with no product, lot, delivery note or discount.
rejections.deduction_line_taxes: A line giving a deposit back states what the deposit charged of each of its taxes.
rejections.above_expected: Only {{quantity}} of “{{reference}}” is still expected: a receipt brings no more than that.
rejections.expiry_needs_lot: A use-by date belongs to a lot: name the lot.
rejections.deposit_rate_or_amount: A deposit is a percentage of the quote or an amount, one of the two.
rejections.invalid_deposit_rate: Deposit refused: a percentage above 0 and below 100, with at most three decimals.
rejections.validity_days: A quote holds its price for one day at least.
rejections.quote_not_accepted: Quote “{{reference}}” is not accepted: only an accepted quote is delivered.
rejections.quote_invoiced_whole: Quote “{{reference}}” is on an invoice made from the whole quote: deliver from that invoice, or cancel that draft first.
rejections.quote_document_discount: Quote “{{reference}}” has a discount on the whole, which an invoice of some of its deliveries cannot share out exactly: invoice the whole quote, then deliver from that invoice.
rejections.quote_has_deposit: Quote “{{reference}}” has a deposit invoice, which only the invoice of the whole quote gives back: invoice the whole quote, then deliver from that invoice.
rejections.not_goods_invoice: “{{reference}}” is a credit note or a deposit invoice: only an invoice of goods is delivered.
rejections.invoice_not_issued: Invoice “{{reference}}” is not issued: a draft bills nothing yet, so deliver its goods by notes first and invoice those notes.
rejections.quote_invoiced_first: Quote “{{number}}” is already on an invoice made from the whole quote: its deposits come before it.
rejections.quote_delivered_by_notes: Quote “{{number}}” is delivered by delivery notes that are not cancelled, whose invoices give no deposit back.
rejections.quote_not_on_invoice: A quote is added to an invoice, never to a credit note or a deposit invoice: choose an invoice.
rejections.quote_other_party: This quote is for another customer or establishment than the invoice: choose an invoice of its customer and establishment.
rejections.quote_discount_own_draft: A quote with a discount on the whole is invoiced on a draft of its own: spread over the other lines of an invoice, it would move tax from one rate to another.
rejections.deposit_below_quote: A deposit is less than the quote, {{amount}} tax included.
rejections.deposit_unit_missing: A deposit line counts in the unit “{{unit}}”, which the company does not have: add it in Units.
rejections.deposit_too_small: A deposit this small comes to nothing in the currency: raise it.
rejections.deposit_still_draft: The deposit invoice drafted on {{day}} is still a draft: issue or cancel it before invoicing the quote.
rejections.lot_required: “{{reference}}” is tracked by lot or serial number: say which one.
rejections.above_on_hand: Only {{quantity}} is at this location: lower the quantity.
rejections.unknown_lot: “{{reference}}” has no lot “{{lot}}”: goods enter a lot by a receipt or a count.
rejections.serial_in_stock: Serial number “{{serial}}” of “{{reference}}” is already in stock.
rejections.vendors_off: Vendors is switched off: a receipt names no vendor.
rejections.lot_dated: Lot “{{lot}}” of “{{reference}}” expires on {{day}}: a lot has only one date.
rejections.lot_in_date: Lot “{{lot}}” of “{{reference}}” has not expired: only an expired lot is released.
rejections.serial_counted: A serial number is a single piece: count 0 or 1.
rejections.above_sold: A return gives back no more than the sale took out, {{quantity}}.
rejections.lot_of_another: Lot “{{lot}}” is not a lot of “{{reference}}”.
rejections.serial_one_piece: A serial number is a single piece: it moves one at a time, quantity 1.
rejections.same_location: The goods are already there: choose another location.
rejections.location_gone: This place has been removed in the meantime: choose another.
rejections.drawing_unbound: This rectangle is linked to no place: link it to a place first, then repeat it.
rejections.stock_short: {{name}}: {{wanted}} {{unit}} needed, the stock recorded holds {{on_hand}} {{unit}}. Count the stock or receive the goods first.
rejections.stock_short_to_confirm: {{name}}: {{wanted}} {{unit}} needed, the stock recorded holds {{on_hand}} {{unit}}. Confirm the sale to go on.
rejections.after_now: This moment has already passed: choose an end still to come.
rejections.before_last_day: The last number was given on {{last}}, and the clock of the computer the application is installed on reads {{today}}: the document would be dated before the previous one. Correct its date and time, or tell the person who looks after that computer, then try again.
rejections.before_last_period: The last number was given on {{last}}, and the clock of the computer the application is installed on reads {{today}}: nothing is numbered before the last numbered month. Correct its date and time, or tell the person who looks after that computer, then try again.
rejections.payment_already_decided: This payment was already confirmed or rejected, perhaps by another operator: the list is read again.
rejections.trial_or_paid_required: Fill in “Trial ends on”, “Paid through” or both: a subscription covers at least one of them.
rejections.filter_refused: The file cannot be made with a filter in this address, from an old link or one changed by hand: choose the list’s filters again, then export.
rejections.selection_count: An action on a selection takes 1 to {{max}} items: select fewer, then try again.
rejections.nothing_to_print: Nothing to print: the invoices chosen are drafts or cancelled invoices whose box is not ticked, or they no longer exist. Tick the box, or choose other invoices.
rejections.leaves_the_floor: This rectangle would leave the plan on this side: bring it closer to the edge or turn it.
rejections.piece_gone: This building element was erased in the meantime: discard the changes touching it, then start again.
rejections.piece_other_floor: This building element is on another floor: change it from its own floor’s plan.
rejections.piece_named_twice: This building element is changed twice in the same changes: keep only one.
rejections.bin_in_rack: A bin is kept in its rack, not on the plan: draw the rack, then create the bin in it.
rejections.code_ends_in_number: The first code ends in a number, which the next ones continue (example: R2).
rejections.rectangle_gone: This rectangle was erased in the meantime: discard the changes touching it, then start again.
rejections.rectangle_other_floor: This rectangle is on another floor: change it from its own floor’s plan.
rejections.rectangle_named_twice: This rectangle is changed twice in the same changes: keep only one.
rejections.place_drawn_twice: This location is drawn twice in the same changes: keep only one.
rejections.place_drawn_elsewhere: This location is already drawn on another rectangle: erase that one first, in the same changes.
rejections.code_taken: The code {{code}} is already another location’s in this establishment: choose another one.
rejections.code_given_twice: This code is given to two new locations: give one of them another.
rejections.note_not_validated: Only a validated note is delivered, and delivery note “{{reference}}” is not, or no longer.
rejections.note_not_invoiceable: Only a validated or delivered note is invoiced, and delivery note “{{reference}}” is not, or no longer.
rejections.note_not_cancellable: Delivery note “{{reference}}” can no longer be cancelled: only a draft or a validated note is.
rejections.note_no_longer_draft: Delivery note “{{reference}}” is no longer a draft: only a draft is changed.
rejections.note_validated_already: Delivery note “{{reference}}” is no longer a draft: it was validated, or cancelled, already.
rejections.receiver_named_as_drafted: A draft’s receiver is named as it is saved, and a cancelled note delivers nothing.
rejections.note_on_draft_invoice: Delivery note “{{reference}}” is on a draft invoice: cancel that draft first.
rejections.note_of_issued_invoice: Delivery note “{{reference}}” hands over the goods of an issued invoice, which billed them already: it is never invoiced again.
rejections.nothing_left_to_invoice: Nothing is left to invoice on these delivery notes.
rejections.notes_on_draft_invoice: These delivery notes are on a draft invoice already: nothing is left to invoice. Open that draft, or cancel it first.
rejections.notes_on_invoice: These delivery notes are on invoice “{{invoice}}”, which is not cancelled: nothing is left to invoice.
rejections.invoice_bills_no_goods: Invoice “{{reference}}” bills no goods to deliver: its lines are services, deductions or goods its delivery notes handed over already.
rejections.invoice_delivered_whole: Nothing is left to deliver on invoice “{{reference}}”: its credit notes and its delivery notes that are not cancelled take all of it.
rejections.quote_delivered_whole: Nothing is left to deliver on quote “{{reference}}”: its delivery notes that are not cancelled take all of it.
rejections.note_on_invoice: Delivery note “{{reference}}” is on invoice “{{invoice}}”, which is not cancelled: it can no longer be cancelled. An issued invoice is corrected by a credit note.
rejections.invoice_not_cancellable: Document “{{reference}}” is issued: only a draft is abandoned, and an issued invoice is corrected by a credit note.
rejections.invoice_receiver_as_drafted: A draft’s receiver is named as it is saved, and an abandoned draft hands nothing over.
rejections.credit_note_of_draft: Only an issued invoice is corrected by a credit note: a draft is changed, and an abandoned draft billed nothing.
rejections.credit_note_not_credited: A credit note is not corrected by another credit note: only an issued invoice is.
rejections.credit_note_not_duplicated: A credit note corrects its invoice: it is not duplicated. Duplicate the invoice, or give it another credit note.
rejections.invoice_not_issued_paid: Only an issued invoice is paid: a draft, abandoned or not, has billed nothing yet.
rejections.credit_note_not_paid: A credit note takes no payment: only an issued invoice is paid.
rejections.still_due: {{amount}} is still due on invoice “{{reference}}”: pay that first, before recording an overpayment.
rejections.invoice_draft_cancelled: This draft is abandoned: it is no longer issued or changed.
rejections.invoice_no_longer_draft: Document “{{reference}}” is issued: only a draft is changed. An issued invoice is corrected by a credit note.
rejections.payment_kept_credited: Invoice “{{reference}}” gave money back through a credit note: its payments are kept.
rejections.payment_kept_cashed: This payment cashed a cheque or traite of invoice “{{reference}}”: it is kept, as the proof the money came.
rejections.instrument_not_held: Only a cheque or traite in the portfolio is deposited: this one is at the bank already, cashed or unpaid.
rejections.instrument_settled: This cheque or traite is already cashed or marked unpaid.
rejections.target_not_draft: The invoice chosen is no longer a draft: delivery notes are added only to a draft. Choose another, or make a new invoice.
rejections.quote_draft_cancelled: This quote draft is abandoned: it is no longer sent or changed.
rejections.quote_no_longer_draft: Quote “{{reference}}” is sent: only a draft is changed.
rejections.quote_not_cancellable: Quote “{{reference}}” is sent: only a draft is abandoned. A sent quote waits for the customer’s answer, accepted or refused.
rejections.quote_not_sent: This quote is a draft: send it first, only a sent quote is accepted or refused.
rejections.quote_answered_already: Quote “{{reference}}” has its answer already: it no longer changes, only who answered is put right.
rejections.quote_not_answered: This quote has no answer yet: who answered is named once the quote is accepted or refused.
rejections.quote_invoice_not_accepted: This quote is not accepted: only an accepted quote is invoiced.
rejections.quote_on_invoice: Quote “{{reference}}” is on an invoice already: to invoice it again, abandon that draft first.
rejections.quote_on_invoice_deposit: Quote “{{reference}}” is on an invoice already: its deposit comes before it.
rejections.quote_invoiced_by_notes: Quote “{{reference}}” is delivered by delivery notes not cancelled: it is invoiced through its notes, with “Invoice this note”.
rejections.quote_deposit_after_notes: Quote “{{reference}}” is delivered by delivery notes not cancelled: a deposit comes before them, and the invoice of its notes would not give it back.
rejections.quote_target_not_draft: The invoice chosen is no longer a draft: a quote is added only to a draft. Choose another, or make a new invoice.
rejections.note_draft_cancelled: This delivery note draft is abandoned: it is no longer validated, delivered or invoiced.
rejections.note_draft_not_validated: This delivery note is a draft: validate it first, only a validated note is delivered.
rejections.note_draft_not_invoiceable: This delivery note is a draft: validate it first, only a validated or delivered note is invoiced.
rejections.invoice_draft_not_delivered: This invoice is a draft: it bills nothing yet. Deliver its goods by notes first, then invoice those notes.
rejections.draft_not_goods_invoice: This draft is a credit note or a deposit invoice: only an invoice of goods is delivered.
rejections.quote_draft_not_accepted: This quote is a draft: only an accepted quote is delivered. Send it, then record the customer’s answer.
rejections.chosen_not_a_deposit: The invoice chosen is not a deposit invoice: only a deposit is given back on another invoice.
rejections.deposit_draft_not_issued: The deposit chosen is a draft: a deposit is given back once issued.
rejections.order_draft_cancelled: This order was cancelled before it was sent: it is no longer sent or changed, and nothing is expected from it.
rejections.order_draft_not_sent: This order is a draft: send it first, goods are received against a sent order.
rejections.order_not_open: Order “{{reference}}” expects nothing more: it is received, closed or cancelled.
rejections.order_partly_received_closed: Part of order “{{reference}}” is received: it is no longer cancelled. Close it if the rest will not come.
rejections.order_not_cancellable: Order “{{reference}}” is no longer cancelled: only an order nothing was received against is cancelled.
rejections.order_draft_not_closed: This order is a draft: only a partly received order is closed. Cancel it if it will not be sent.
rejections.order_nothing_arrived: Nothing of order “{{reference}}” is received yet: it is cancelled, not closed.
rejections.order_not_closable: Order “{{reference}}” is not closed: only a partly received order is closed.
rejections.order_no_longer_draft: Order “{{reference}}” is sent: only a draft is changed.
